observations: Two stacked white plastic tanks with metal frames, each on a pallet.
The top tank has a blue spigot and a white cap, with visible rust on the metal frame and base.
The bottom tank has a similar design with a white cap and a blue spigot.
Both tanks show signs of dirt, algae, and water stains, especially on the sides and bottom.
Labels are present on both tanks, but the text is not legible in any photo.
The tanks appear to be used and possibly damaged, with some cracks or warping visible on the plastic.
The setting is outdoors, on a concrete ground next to a wall with mossy blocks.
No visible brand or model name on the tanks or frames.
The seller claims it can be used for fish pond, water storage, or diesel, but no proof of intended use is shown.
